answer: For a dune restoration market, a public beacon selects audits of agents hired to maintain a bridge. Each job must reserve collateral in a shared escrow; one deposit cannot back overlapping jobs under different keys. Payment follows independently verified delivery, with no signup bonus, and proven nondelivery burns the reserved bond. A thousand identities provide neither extra collateral nor free income: an attacker must lock fresh capital for every concurrent fraudulent job and risks losing it. Auditors must remain outside the bidder's control.
